newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Ind says places 80 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Allied Ind says places 80 mln new shares.

text.p: Allied Industries Ltd has agreed to issue 80 million new shares, or nine percent of the enlarged share capital, to parent Wiseway Enterprises Ltd at HK$1.65 each, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Allied said Wiseway had agreed to place out the same amount of existing shares at the same price to third party investors before subscribing the new shares.
On completion of the deal on April 7, the shareholding of Wiseway will be diluted to 46 percent from 50.6 percent.
Of the net proceeds of HK$130.8 million, Allied said HK$30 million would be used to reduce borrowings and the rest for working capital.
Allied said the deal would secure additional working capital for expansion of existing businesses, which include financial services, transportation and petrochemicals.
Trading in Allied shares resumed on Tuesday after a one-day suspension. They were up HK$0.06 to HK$1.81 in early trade.
